name: Easter
overview: Easter centers on the resurrection of Jesus Christ, a foundational truth revealed in Scripture as Mary Magdalene and others discovered the empty tomb early on the first day of the week (Matthew 28:1; Mark 16:1; Luke 24:1). The angel's declaration that Jesus is risen (Luke 24:6) confirms His victory over death, fulfilling His promise of eternal life to all who believe in Him (John 3:16; John 11:25). This event affirms Jesus as the resurrection and the life, offering hope beyond physical death for those who place their faith in Him.
